content: Jerusalen janin Jesus nocotai
Jerusalen hochoma sca becani. Betfagé jema pishca qui nocotax, Olivo manan qui nococani. Janoxon sca jahuen haxenica rabe raannoxon yohiquin.
—Hoa hoque jai jema janin caxon tah man caballo meraxihqui. Nexa tah man meraxihqui, jahuen baqueyabi. Rabebi pecaxon jahuen baqueyabi hea bexontannahue.
Jahueja man jain hahcá, Noquen Hihbo ta nea pishinihqui hihnahue. Jaatian ta mato bexonmatihiqui —jato jaquin.
Neateman Papan joi huishanicabaan yohini quescabijaquin janon ta jato jascajanishqui.

content.text: Jerusalen janin jihuetaibo nescajaquin yohinahue: Jisnahue. Maton quiquin hapo ta nocoti jahuiqui. Quiquin hapobo jahui quescarihma bi joni quesca jahuiqui, caballo cahtsahotax. Caballo baque res cahtsahotax ta jahuiqui, noquen jahuaborabo noque papixonnica caballo baquen ta jahuiqui

content: hihqui jaa huisha.
Jan yohihah quesca sca caxon, nexa sca caballo meracanquin jahuen haxenicabaan.
Pecaxon, jahuen baqueyabi becanquin. Caballo baque jaton chopa cahpohenxon, jano Jesus cahtsahonbenacanquin.
Hihti caibaan jaton cotonbo pecaxon jano Jesus jonoxihqui bahinbi mijancanquin, hahan jonon. Caibaan rihbi jepe pehi xatexon jascajaribiquin, mijanquin.
Caibo bebohi becani, caibo rihbi hahchon becani. Quenáhonahi becani: —David xohtahi ta jahuiqui. Hahxonhue. Papa Diosen janen ta jahuiqui. Papan shinanya ta jahuiqui. Jaa hahxonhue, Papan —hihcani.
Jascahah, Jerusalen janin hihcohi. Jaa jema janinhahbo jatihibi rahte rahtetax: —¿Tsoa hin? —hihcani.
—Nea ta Papan joiya jahui joni qui, Jesus. Galilea mai mehax nocoti jahui, Nazaret jema janinhax nocoti jahui —hihcani, tsamajaquetaibo.
Papan xobo janin tiromabo jan camahi

Papan xoboho sca Jesus mapeti. Mapexon, janoxon marohiton jonibo meraxon, maromahiton rihbi meraxon, jascapahbo jatihibi camaquin. Jato picomaxon, jaton coriqui mahnenanti mesabo behonxon, nobex maromanicahbaan tsahotibo hueranbohanxon, jato yohiquin:
—Papan huishani joi janin ta nea jaiqui: Heen xobo ta janoxon hea yohiti xobo qui. Jascapa xobo hihqui bi tah man jano yometso tsamati jaa xobo jai —jato jaquin.
Jaatian sca bencheboya chantobo jaa xoboho mapeti, Jesus jano jai copi. Jato jisxon, jaan jato rohajaquin.
Jahuen coshi shinaman jan jato hahxonai jisxon sacerdote hapobo betan jaton huisha honanbo sinati. Papan xoboho baquebo quenatai, Davidi xohta hahxonhue hihquibo nincacax, sina sinacani.

Sinaxon, Jesus yocacanquin: —¿Jaabo yohuanai min nincayamahin? —hahcanquin. —Nincaquin rahan. ¿Baquebo tah min mihqui siripi yohuanmahi, baquexobo rihbi, hihqui Papan huishani joi, man jahuentianbi jaa jisyamaniquin? —jato jaquin.
Jato jenebahini sca picoti cahax huetsa jema janin cahi, Betania jema. Jano sca hoxashinahi.
Jesusen jihui xanamahi
Xaba paquetaiya sca jahuex Jerusalen janin nocotax picatsihscai.
Bahi quexabi bimi jihui huesti meraxon, bimi bichi caha bi yamahi. Pehi rahsi jai. —Jahuentianbi bimiyamaxihhue —hahquin, jihui. Jan yohihah, xanacahinscai.
Jan yohiha jihui choshihi jisish, rahte rahtetax jahuen haxenicabo yohuani: —¿Jenquetsahpi jaa jihui xanacahinihquin? —hihcani.

Yohuanai nincaxon, jato yohiquin: —Man honannon hihxon tah hen mato yohihi. Papan mato hahxoncointihi honanxon, hahxonyama rah ta hea jatihiqui shinanyamaxon tah man jascapa yohiti hahtipahtihi. Jascapah res ma bi tah man hoa manan quescapahbo rihbi yohitihi, Huenihihnatax hoa hiaman paquehue. Shinancoinxon man yohihah ta man yohihi quescatihiqui.
Papan mato hahxontihi honancoinxon man yocacai jatihibi ta jaan mato hahxonyaxihquiqui.
Tsoan yohihah min jascajahin hihquibo

Jaatian sca nocotax Papan xoboho mapexon jano nocohihnatai jonibo haxemaquin. Jato haxemahiya bi sacerdote hapobo becani, jaton hahbe hapobo betan. Joxon: —¿Tsoan mia jascajahue hahca min neno jascajahipiquin? —hahcanquin.
—Mato rihbi tah hen huestijaquin yocatihi. Man hea yohihiya tah hen tsoan hea jascajahue hahcai hen mato yohirihbitihi.

¿Tsoan yohihah Juaman nashimapahonishquin? ¿Papan yohihah nan? ¿Jonibaan res yohihah nan? —jato jaáh bi jahuahihyama sca jacani. Jaabo rahsibi res yohinani. —Papan yohihah rahan hih non jaiya ta noque yocaxihquiqui, Jahua copi sca man Juaman yohihah bi nincayamanihquin.
Jonibaan res rahan hih tah non jatimaribihi. Tsamataibaan noque jenquetsah ra jamis. Juan Papan joi yohinica hihpahoni ta shinancaniqui —hihcani, jaabo rahsibi yohinani.
Yohinanxon sca: —Non tah non honanyamahi —hahcanquin Jesus. —Hean rihbi tah hen tsoan hea jascajahue hahcai mato yohiyamarihbihi —jato jaquin.
Rabe bebo baqueya
Man jaa shinannon tah hen mato yohihi. Rabe bebo baqueya joni ta japahonishqui. Jahuen beboquiha baque ta yohinishqui: —Rahma noquen huai chian teetanhue, baquen —hahquin.
Jascahah bi: —Hen tah hen queenyamahi —hihqui. Jascarax bi chini sca pontejaquin shinanax, teeti cahi, huai chian.
Jahuen chini sca jahuen papan jascajaquin rihbi yonoquin. —Teeti rahan, Papan —hahcax bi jahuen chini baque cayamaribihi.

Hea yohinahue: ¿Jahuemehaton jahuen papan yohiha quescabijanishquin? —Jahuen baque beboquihaton rahan —hahcanquin. —Hihcoini. Jascarihbihi ta coriqui cobranmisboya tsini haibobo mato bebohi bocanihqui Papan jihuemati janin cacatsihqui.

Papan bahin canoxon ponte jihueti Juaman mato yohihah bi tah man nincayamanihqui. Coriqui cobranmisbaan caya ta nincanishqui. Tsini haibobaan rihbi. Jaabaan nincacoinscai jisxon maton rihbi chini sca pontejaquin shinanxon nincacointihi bi tah man nincacoinyamahi.
Tiromabo teexonnicahbo

Huetsa jahan haxeti joi nincanahue. Huesti jonin ta hani huaijanishqui. Jahuen huai banaxon, jahuen senenjatibo honantijanoxon chiquebohanxon, hahan bishtaxmatijaxon, janoxon coiranti xobojaxon, jahuen huai coirantibo yohihax joribiyanoxon cahi caresscai.
Jahuen huai tsinquiti tian sca, jahuen jonibo raanquin, jahuen coirannicahban jahuen bimi hinannon hihxon.
Raanah sca nococani. Nocotaiton bi jahuen coirannicahbaan jato yahtanquin. Huetsa rishquixon, huetsa rehtexon, huetsa rihbi macaman tsacaquin rehtecanquin.
Jaa pecaho sca huetsa jahuen jonibo sca huai hihbaan raanrihbiquin, hashoan hicha sca. Raanah nocotaiton jato jascajaribicanquin.
Chini sca jahuen baquebi raanquin. Heen baque ta nincayaxihcanihqui hihxon jaa raanquin.
Jahuen baque nocoti jahui merahax, yohinancani: —Nea ta huai hihbo hihyaxihquiqui, jahuen papa mahuataiya. Jaa rihbi rehtenon benahue noquenah sca jahuen huai hihnon —hihcani.
Nocotaiton sca yahtanxon, huai mapoho boxon rehtecanquin.
¿Joxon sca jaa huai hihbaan jahua jato jati quin? —Jesusen jato jaquin.
—Jato ta tiromajaquin rehtetihiqui. Jahuen huai rihbi ta huetsa coirannicahbo hinantahtihiqui, bimi jai tian jahuenah hinanyaxihquibo —hahcanquin.
—¿Papan huishani joi janin man nea jahuentianbi jisyamaniquin?

content.text: Tiroma tah qui hihxon xobojahibaan potani xobo jihui ta hahqui xobojati qui. Papa Diosen ta jaa caisihqui. Jan hahcai shinanax tah non rahtetai

content: hihqui jaa joi.
Jaa copi tah hen mato yohihi: Papan ta mato jahuen jihue bichinyaxihquiqui. Mato bichinxon ta maton nahuabo sca hinanyaxihquiqui, jahuen joi jai quescabijahibo.
Jaa jihui qui paquetaibo ta tobitihiqui. Jato qui jaa jihui paquetah ta moshi moshitaibo jayaxihquiqui —jato jaquin.
Hahan haxeti joi jan yohihi nincaxon, jato qui jan jayaxon yohihi jaton hapobaan honanquin.
Jaa bihcatsihquish bi jonibo qui raquexon bihyamacanquin. Papan joi yohinica tah qui hihquibo sinacahincanmis hihquish raquecani.
